# Synch engine source

Source: https://github.com/AFK-surf/synchronicity/tree/6d6283f09c32476dc77c09f76a2b2529a42a558d/crates/synch-engine

The manifest resolves upstream workspace dependencies at that revision. Local changes publish real directory entries through the existing scanner, including deletion and restart reconciliation, and bound publication latency during continuous writes. Original licenses are retained.
